programs.title: The Zoo
programs.desc: At the zoo and the New York Aquarium, bull sea lions Clyde and Tacoma trade places to meet a new set of girlfriends; Sifaka lemurs Gemina and Andri form a new breeding pair to help their species.

programs.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programs.desc: An owner drives nine hours to the clinic hoping Dr. Jeff can save her dog's leg; Jeff and his team head to a wildlife sanctuary to treat a pack of wolves; when a kitten with a deformed leg needs treatment, Dr. Baier steps up to the plate.

programs.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programs.desc: Dr. Jeff must act fast to save a bulldog after a life-threatening accident; when devastating floods hit Louisiana, Dr. Jeff sends vet tech Hector to rescue pets left homeless in the disaster; Dr. Don operates on a cat with a bad habit.

programs.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programs.desc: A boxer kicked in the head by a horse requires urgent surgery to repair its skull; Dr. Jeff helps a woman with a rapidly expanding feral cat colony in her backyard; Dr. Baier preps for delicate surgery on a beloved ferret with a facial growth.

programs.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programs.desc: Two sisters rush their tiny dog to the clinic with a life-threatening brain injury; a dog with a broken jaw perplexes Dr. Jeff; a fearless cat with a broken leg wins the admiration of the clinic staff; the team treats some uncooperative yaks.

programs.title: Dr. Dee: Alaska Vet
programs.desc: Dr. Dee hosts a pet tricks competition to raise funds for a no-kill animal shelter in Fairbanks; surgery for a pot-bellied pig named Lilly Lou is full of surprises; stallion of Dr. Dee's long-time friend has a possibly deadly tumor.
